description: EV2Gym is Stavros Orfanoudakis and collaborators' Python environment for developing and comparing electric-vehicle charging and vehicle-to-grid controllers. It represents vehicles, chargers, transformers, battery ageing and optional distribution-network power flow. Users supply YAML configuration, charging topology, arrival behaviour, prices and load or solar profiles; outputs include states, rewards, evaluation metrics and replay files. Geographic coverage is configurable, with several default inputs based on Dutch or European sources and a user-selected time step. Public source is free under MIT. A limitation is that some transformer-load and demand-response options are incompatible with the grid-simulation mode, and optimal replay baselines require a separate Gurobi solver. Sample distributions do not establish representativeness for a new fleet. EV2Gym supports charging-control and grid-capacity simulations, complementary to PyPSA (model-pypsa). The README provides a complete example and cites its IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems paper. No vehicle data, solver or model weights were downloaded.
name: EV2Gym electric-vehicle charging simulator
